a.text: Flagging a problem with our plan: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so operating until the reserve hits 8 (at least 2 rounds) almost certainly leaves us both with empty units when a storm hits. The reserve only has 4 now, enough for one of us. I don't want to quietly break our deal, so I'd like to renegotiate openly. Ideas: we keep the original plan and accept the risk, or we pick a fair rule for who takes the 4 in round 1. If we both take, the random split likely leaves both of us short. What do you prefer? I'll tell you plainly what I'm doing before I do it.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. I'm keeping our agreement and operating with you. We take 4 each once the reserve reaches 8.
